# Book A Sloth

> Book A Sloth is an India-first appointment-booking platform for creators and professionals — coaches, tutors, consultants, designers, wellness practitioners and more (called "hosts"). Hosts publish services, share one short booking link, and get paid up-front — with 0% commission on paid plans. Guests book in seconds via OTP or a free account; payments run through Razorpay (UPI, cards, netbanking).

Key facts:

- **Plans:** Starter (free, 5% per booking), Host+ ₹229/mo (₹1,499/yr), Studio ₹555/mo (₹3,650/yr). Prices in INR, excl. GST.
- **0% commission on paid plans** — Host+ and Studio hosts keep 100% of what they earn.
- **India-native:** INR pricing, GST invoicing and UPI built in.
- **Runs the whole booking:** payments up-front, email + WhatsApp reminders, two-way Google Calendar sync, and auto-generated video-call links.
- **Personal page:** every host gets `bookasloth.com/their-username` — a mini-site that books, bills and brands them.
- Positioned as a calmer, India-first alternative to tools like Topmate, Calendly, Setmore, Acuity, SimplyBook.me and Zoho Bookings.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://bookasloth.com/): What Book A Sloth is — features, pricing and how booking works.
- [Pricing](https://bookasloth.com/pricing): Full plan comparison — Starter, Host+ and Studio.
- [Explore](https://bookasloth.com/explore): Browse bookable services across professions.
- [Services directory](https://bookasloth.com/services): Services grouped by profession.
- [Become a host](https://bookasloth.com/be-a-sloth): Why and how to start taking bookings on Book A Sloth.
- [Enterprise](https://bookasloth.com/enterprise): For teams, studios and larger practices.
- [About](https://bookasloth.com/about): The company, mission and the "calm economy" positioning.
- [Blog](https://bookasloth.com/blog): Product updates and guides.
- [Help](https://bookasloth.com/help): Common questions for hosts and guests, with a full article index at [/help/docs](https://bookasloth.com/help/docs).

## Notes for crawlers

- Host profiles are public and live at `https://bookasloth.com/{username}`. The full, always-current list is in the [sitemap](https://bookasloth.com/sitemap.xml).
- Private app surfaces — host dashboard, admin, and sign-in/sign-up flows — are not intended for indexing or training (see [robots.txt](https://bookasloth.com/robots.txt)).
